$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every assistant-platform package in this directory (issue #16614, ADR-0383 (proposed), ADR-0385 (proposed, PR #16611)). Name, logo and MCP URL are defined here once; scripts/generate.py renders every package from this file and scripts/check.py fails when a package, or the tool list, drifts from it. The bank-assigned display name and logo shown on the consent screen and in the app (ADR-0385 D1, 'The bank names the client': assigned by the bank, never taken from vendor metadata) must be these values; the customers-realm client entries are to be generated from this file when they exist. Values starting with OWNER-SUPPLIED are placeholders only the owner can fill.

identity.description: Read connected OpenBank accounts and balances, and draft payment proposals that you approve yourself in the OpenBank app.
identity.longDescription: Connect your personal OpenBank account to ask about the accounts you shared and their balances. The assistant can also draft a payment proposal. Nothing leaves your account until you open the OpenBank app and approve that exact proposal with strong customer authentication. Data you ask about is sent to the assistant platform's provider. You can see and revoke every connected assistant in the OpenBank app.

icon.source: OpenBank brand mark from the verified 0.1.1 ChatGPT import archive

server.$comment: Public customer MCP route and RFC 9728 metadata. Package release and hosted-client admission have separate prerequisites.

scopes.$comment: Read + propose only (ADR-0383 D3/D4, ADR-0385 D1). Scope NAMES are proposed here; no realm defines them yet.

admission.$comment: Per ADR-0385 D1 (proposed). Only a Tier H hosted client that authenticates as a confidential client at BOTH token and refresh, or a Tier L local client with DPoP, is admitted. Tier H default is private_key_jwt against an allowlisted JWKS with a pinned key-set hash. Pre-registration is the default; CIMD is used only if ADR-0385 D7 item 9 shows Keycloak 26.8.1 supports it. Public-client paths are 'not supported by the bank'.

openai-chatgpt-directory.default: pre-registered client with private_key_jwt (OpenAI 'predefined OAuth client'); whether OpenAI's predefined client can use private_key_jwt rather than a secret is UNVERIFIED
openai-chatgpt-directory.status: candidate; vendor docs read 2026-11-17, bank side not built

anthropic-claude-directory.default: private_key_jwt - not offered for an Anthropic-held listing client per the docs read 2026-11-17

exception.tokenEndpointAuthMethod: client_secret (Anthropic-held, entered by the owner in the developer portal)
exception.conditions: EXCEPTION ONLY (ADR-0385 D1): recorded, time-boxed <= 6 months, owner risk acceptance, secret >= 256 bits per bank, rotated <= 90 days, never logged; the expiry date is a field of the allowlist declaration and after it the authorization server answers invalid_client; renewal needs a new owner risk acceptance

anthropic-claude-directory.status: candidate only as a secret exception; vendor docs read 2026-11-17, bank side not built

notSupportedByTheBank: Claude custom connector added by URL (uses Anthropic's CIMD as a public client, or DCR; never the portal secret)
Claude Code (own CIMD public client; loopback redirect on localhost, which ADR-0385 D1 does not accept - only 127.0.0.1/[::1]; DPoP not documented) - Tier L requires DPoP
ChatGPT/Codex custom MCP server typed by URL with token_endpoint_auth_method none
Codex local CLI OAuth, until verified to be either the hosted confidential client or a DPoP-capable local client
Any Dynamic Client Registration path (DCR is off, ADR-0383 D1)

tools.$comment: The connection-bound customer MCP tool set. scripts/check.py verifies the names, action, properties and required arguments against CustomerReadTools and CustomerPaymentProposer.

included.name: list_accounts
included.title: List my accounts
included.description: List the accounts you connected to this assistant.

included.name: get_balance
included.title: Get account balance
included.description: Get the current balance of one of your connected accounts.

included.name: propose_payment
included.title: Propose a payment
included.description: Draft a payment proposal for separate approval in the OpenBank app with strong customer authentication. Reuse the same clientRequestId to retry.

excluded.name: list_transactions
excluded.reason: This customer tool is unavailable when the connection is bound.

adrStatus.note: Everything below mirrors PROPOSALS. If either ADR changes before acceptance, this file follows it.

deliveryChecks.$comment: scripts/check.py --release refuses until every entry is MET. The descriptions in this file (longDescription, tool descriptions) state TARGET behaviour; --release is the control that stops them being published before that behaviour exists.
